excerpt: On June 23, 2026, ... P-ONE-1, successfully completed its final pre-deployment shallow-water test ... the collaboration aims to deploy P-ONE-1, including the full acoustic calibration infrastructure on the seafloor, by the end of August 2026. Detector commissioning and initial data-taking activities will commence immediately following deployment.
title: Successful wet test of P-ONE-1 in Vancouver's Granville Island (P-ONE news, June 2026)
